name: Blooming Onion
body:
Station and Complexity friturier 5

Flavor Profiles sweet, salty, texture, temperature, texture
Additional Ingredients sour or spicy

EFFECT

Duration 1 round/level; Serving Size 1
Saving Throw Fortitude half; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

A blooming onion is usually a large, sweet onion cut to resemble a flower, battered, and deep-fried until golden brown and crispy.

When consumed, it deals 1d6 damage per level (maximum 15d6). Half of this damage is acid and the other half is electricity.

Additional ingredients increase the serving size by +1 each.

Additional spicy ingredients can change either damage type to fire (your choice).
